# New_Boss.mqo inspection

The unnamed large raid-boss source was parsed and rendered before conversion.

## Result
It is **not another Dragon Ball / DBZ character**.

The mesh is a large armored berserker/demon-style humanoid:
- extremely muscular body;
- dark horned/spiked armour silhouette;
- large forearm/boot spikes;
- blue-grey body;
- bright cyan/green torso/stomach material.

The MQO itself reinforces that identification: one of the source material groups is named `kuangzhanshi`, commonly transliterating the Chinese term for "berserker". Other active material labels include `helmet`, `body`, `stomach`, `brown`, `gray`, `helmet1`, `helmet2`, and `helmet3`.

## Source structure
- file: `New_Boss.mqo`
- SHA-256: `1d6b367031d02ea06286b9e89fd2a59bbae37a91375e7622d2313adb24c84801`

Keep it in the queue as the custom large raid boss, not as DBZ content.
